title: EAP: improve TEAP/PEAP and EAPOL TLS decoding
description:
It has been a while since the EAP dissector received some love, this set of commits tries to make things better.

 - PEAP support did not actually decode inner attributes, whilst in there also add support to decode some of the MSAUTH-TLV attributes too
 - added TEAP Outer-TLV support so the TLS dissector no longer receives garbage
 - massage `pinfo` so for EAPOL traffic the TLS dissector does not get lost tracking conversations (caused by the presence of multicast traffic)

commits_data.message:
EAP: add PEAP decoder

The existing PEAP support does not decode the inner attributes, this
commit adds that support by introducing packet-peap.c which recreates
a 'pseudo' EAP header before looping the TVB back into the EAP dissector.
